meaning.zh:
“园艺高手” 或 “非常擅长种植植物的人”。

这个短语起源于那些具备特别好的园艺技能的人，因为他们的手指总是被植物的绿色给染上了。拥有 “green thumb” 意味着你有能力使植物健康茂盛地生长，通常用来形容一个在园艺方面表现特别出色的人。
meaning.en: This phrase originates from those who have exceptional gardening skills, as their fingers are always "colored green" from handling plants. Having a "green thumb" means you have the ability to make plants grow healthily and thrive. It is usually used to describe someone who excels in gardening.

lines.en: She must have a *green thumb* because her garden is always full of beautiful flowers.
lines.zh: 她一定是个园艺高手，因为她的花园总是开满了美丽的花朵。

lines.en: My grandfather has a *green thumb*; he can turn any barren land into a lush garden.
lines.zh: 我爷爷是个园艺高手；他能把任何一片贫瘠的土地变成郁郁葱葱的花园。

lines.en: Even though I don't have a *green thumb*, I enjoy trying to grow plants in my spare time.
lines.zh: 即使我不是园艺高手，我还是喜欢在空闲时间尝试种植植物。
